title: Sum mixed-module images with explicitly computed positive adjacent weights
statement: For conjugate inner type nu_j and adjacent image coordinates a,c, the reported weight T_j(a,c)=q^[nu_j c+b(nu_j-a)] product_(h=c)^(a-1)(q^nu_j-q^h) combines onto-left maps and right lifts. Explicit nonnegative adjacent-coordinate factors admit the same compressed partition sum and actual-image sampling.

requires: Whole acquired Hom space, faithful mixed inner module and actual field/ring transports
Free output R^p and complete target
Explicitly computed nonnegative weights, not an uncomputed oracle
provides: Positive weighted-image counting and actual embedded-image sampling
assumptions: No exact length cancellation is required
Nonfree output requires the additional filtered-image data
Whole-space equality is checked after equalizer acquisition
costs: O(e p) states/O(e p^2) scalar transitions plus actual-coordinate algebra, factor lifting, integer bit costs and output checks
contract.units: Exact finite-field dimensions, integer populations and rational probabilities; wall-clock observations in seconds.
contract.obstruction: A total left image loses the nested lifting information for nonfree outputs.
